description: Recommend up to 4 curated hairstyles that suit a face shape, from the Style Look Lab hairstyle library. Each result has a name, a short description, a link to try the hairstyle on your own photo, and (when available) a link to the full hairstyle guide. face_shape: oval, round, square, heart, diamond, oblong or triangle. gender: female or male (selects the hairstyle catalog). length: optional filter, short, medium or long.
name: recommend_hairstyles
title: Recommend hairstyles for a face shape
